# Down to Earth

> India's leading environmental journalism platform delivering news, analysis, and data on climate change, water resources, agriculture, and sustainability across South Asia.

Down to Earth is a comprehensive environmental news and analysis platform operated by the Centre for Science and Environment (CSE). The site provides in-depth coverage of environmental issues affecting India and South Asia, with multilingual editions in Hindi and Malayalam, educational initiatives for young audiences, and curated data resources for researchers and policymakers.

## Key Topics

- Climate Change
- Water Crisis
- Himalayan Glaciers
- Water-Food Nexus
- Agriculture & Farming
- Environmental Sustainability
- Air Pollution
- Waste Management
- Health & Environment
- ICIMOD Reports
- World Water Day
- South Asia
- Environmental Journalism
- Biodiversity
- Water Resources

## Core Platforms

- [Down to Earth English](https://www.downtoearth.org.in): Main homepage with environmental news, climate analysis, water and sustainability coverage
- [Down to Earth Hindi](https://hindi.downtoearth.org.in): Hindi language version of Down to Earth environmental journalism
- [Down to Earth Malayalam](https://malayalam.downtoearth.org.in): Malayalam language edition covering environment, science, climate change news
- [The Young Environmentalist](https://young.downtoearth.org.in): Environmental education initiative promoting awareness among young audiences

## Environmental Topics

- [Climate Change](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/climate-change): Climate change news and impact analysis for India and global regions
- [Water Crisis & Resources](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/water): Water crisis news including Himalayan glaciers, water resources, climate impacts
- [Agriculture & Farming](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/agriculture): Agriculture news covering farming, crop updates, farm machinery in India regions
- [Air Pollution & Quality](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/air): Air pollution and quality index updates focusing on Delhi and India
- [Waste Management](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/waste): Waste management news covering plastic, recycling, environmental sustainability
- [Food & Biodiversity](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/food): Food and biodiversity news with stories, recipes, environmental food issues

## Health & Regional Coverage

- [Health Updates](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/health): Health news and medical updates covering diseases, nutrition, healthcare in India
- [Africa Environmental News](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/africa): Africa environmental news covering climate, water, wildlife conservation

## Featured Investigations

- [Himalayan Glaciers: 50 Years of Ice Loss Equivalent to a Six-Storied Building](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/water/himalaya-ice-loss-in-the-last-50-years-equivalent-to-a-six-storied-building-says-icimod): ICIMOD report on Himalayan glacier ice loss and climate change impacts
- [World Water Day 2026: Hindukush Himalaya Ice Loss Doubles Since 2000](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/water/world-water-day-2026-ice-loss-rate-in-the-hindukush-himalaya-doubled-since-2000-says-icimod): World Water Day report on doubled ice loss in Hindukush Himalaya region
- [World Bank's New Water-Food Nexus Framework for Feeding 10 Billion by 2050](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/water/world-bank-report-suggests-new-water-food-nexus-framework-for-smarter-hydrological-use-to-feed-10-billion-people): World Bank water-food nexus framework for sustainable agriculture and food security
- [250 Million Hours a Day: Women's Unpaid Labour in Global Water Crisis](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/water/250-million-hours-a-day-womens-unpaid-labour-sustaining-global-water-crisis-finds-un-report): UN report on women's unpaid water collection labor and gender inequality
- [Jhelum River Drying: Impact of Kashmir's Rainfall Deficit and Rising Temperatures](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/rivers/why-is-jammu-kashmirs-jhelum-river-drying-after-winter): Analysis of Jhelum River drying in Kashmir due to climate change impacts
- [India's Dry Winter and Rapid Shift to Summer: A Climate Perspective](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/climate-change/it-feels-as-if-the-spring-never-arrived): Climate analysis of India's seasonal weather patterns and El Niño impacts

## Data & Multimedia Resources

- [Data Centre](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/collection/data-centre): Environmental and health data collection, statistics, state of environment reports
- [Videos](https://www.downtoearth.org.in/collection/videos): Multimedia video collection on environmental issues, water crisis, climate change
